items.title: Special Weather Statement issued May 9 at 5:43AM CDT by NWS Duluth MN
items.summary:
Dry conditions and breezy winds will lead to near critical fire
weather conditions today. Northwest winds of 10 to 15 mph with
gusts of 20 to 25 mph are forecast for this afternoon into the
evening. Minimum relative humidity values of 20 to 25 percent are
also expected. Together, these conditions could lead to the rapid
spread of fires. Check burning restrictions and fire danger before
burning.

For more information on burning restrictions for Minnesota, see
www.dnr.state.mn.us/forestry/fire/fir
